messages:
Amy: Tiny idea — Mini Mug Exchange + Joy Card chain. Drop a small mug (clean) or a handwritten one-line joy card in the box by Thu 5pm. Optional: photo for collage. :coffee:

Ben: In. Can mugs be thrifted?

Amy: Yes thrifted totally fine. No liquids, please. Wrap so nothing breaks.

Cleo: Remote folks: e-card option is great. DM me and Ill print and add to the pile.

Omar: Ill bring tissue paper and tape. Happy to label donations. Also can take the collage photo.

Nia: Signup sheet: https://intranet.redwood/mug-exchange-2025. Small prize: quirky sticker pack for a random pick.

ops-bot: Reminder: Mini Mug Exchange drop-off closes Thu 5:00 PM. Please avoid perishables and open flames.

Amy: Collage will be posted Fri morning. Thanks everyone — low-effort cheer only, please! :sparkles:
